benchmark_name: Independent Conjugation-2 infinitive morphology challenge v9
publisher: Akadeemiye-Goboleedka Af-soomaaliga / Intergovernmental Academy of Somali Language
source_work: Afmaal. Proceedings of the Conference on the 40th Anniversary of Somali Orthography, Djibouti, 17-21 December 2012
notes: Frozen after the first finite Conjugation-2A runtime slice (kari -> karisaa) merged and before any Fayruus-informed runtime development. The positive set contains only infinitive forms explicitly printed in Fayruus pp. 52-53. Positive lemmas cafi, layli, caddee, cashee, and malee are outside the existing finite Class-I and Conjugation-2 development profiles. Fayruus becomes evaluation-only for these answers after freeze and may not be used to authorize runtime rules targeting v9 answers.
